name: threadline-review
description: Read Python methods, calls, effects, tests, and Git changes together, directly from source.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Threadline starts a locally configured Python interpreter to analyze saved source.

virtualWorkspaces.description: This version needs a filesystem workspace and Python 3.12+.

threadline.pythonPath.description: Trusted Python 3.12+ executable (not a shell command). Empty uses python3, then python. No project environment activation is needed.
threadline.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Trusted Python 3.12+ executable (not a shell command). Empty uses `python3`, then `python`. Use **Threadline: Choose Python Interpreter…** to pick one. No project environment activation is needed.

threadline.sourceRoots.description: Optional source directories relative to the workspace folder.

threadline.exclude.description: Additional relative path/glob exclusions for analysis.

threadline.refreshOnSave.description: Refresh an open review automatically after Python files are saved or changed on disk. Turn off for very large repositories and use Threadline: Refresh Review instead.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Threadline
walkthroughs.description: Read a Python method with its calls, effects, tests, and callers beside the code, without running anything.

steps.title: Open a Python project
steps.description: Threadline reads your **saved** Python source. It never imports or runs it, and nothing leaves your machine.\nOpen a folder with Python files and trust the workspace.\n[Open Folder](command:workbench.action.files.openFolder)

steps.title: Review the function you are reading
steps.description: Put the cursor in a Python function, then select the Threadline button in the editor title bar or the **Threadline** item in the status bar.\n[Review Function at Cursor](command:threadline.reviewFunction)

steps.title: Start from the whole project
steps.description: Browse endpoints, commands, and modules, then open any method to follow its calls.\n[Review Workspace](command:threadline.reviewWorkspace)

steps.title: Review a branch or your uncommitted edits
steps.description: Compare saved files with HEAD, a branch, or a tag and see which methods changed, and what calls them.\n[Review Git Changes](command:threadline.reviewChanges)

steps.title: If Python cannot be found
steps.description: Threadline needs Python 3.12 or newer. Pick the interpreter it should use; it is checked before it is saved.\n[Choose Python Interpreter…](command:threadline.choosePython)

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test tests/client.test.cjs && node scripts/test.mjs
